prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Axiom Rail. Character visual motifs: compact mechanic with one offset railcart cannon on the shoulder and a hydraulic knee, not a shapeshifting hammer/rifle.
TOP LEFT: Gauge Check. Ability concept: when Axiom's attack travels within 12 GU of one of his rails it accrues a Gauge token (max 3). Rails are visible to enemies and may be dismantled.
TOP RIGHT: Lay Track. Ability concept: draws one 65-GU segment on legal ground, with open endpoints and a 2-HP switching junction. Max two segments active for 5 s; rail cannot bisect spawn or an objective collision.
BOTTOM LEFT: Switch Engine. Ability concept: sends a small unmanned rail cart along connected track for up to 2.5 s. It fires light suppressive bolts **only at targets with direct LOS from the cart**; enemies can destroy it or stand away from the rail.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Terminal Delivery. Ability concept: charges a heavy shell on the **furthest linked cart/rail endpoint** for 0.9 s, then fires one broad, telegraphed 95-GU shot aligned to the track. Consumes Gauge for range **not** lethal damage. If no rail survives, R refuses cast and preserves cooldown.
